senses.gloss: a movement of the body that expresses an idea or feeling

definition_translations.zh_TW: 表達想法或感受的身體動作
definition_translations.ja_JP: 考えや感情を表す体の動き
definition_translations.vi_VN: chuyển động cơ thể thể hiện ý tưởng hoặc cảm xúc
definition_translations.th_TH: การเคลื่อนไหวของร่างกายที่แสดงความคิดหรือความรู้สึก

senses.gloss: an action that shows an intention, feeling, or attitude
senses.example: The manager sent flowers as a gesture of sympathy.

translations.th_TH: การแสดงออก

example_translations.zh_TW: 經理送花作為表達慰問的舉動。
example_translations.ja_JP: マネージャーは弔意を示すしるしとして花を送った。
example_translations.vi_VN: Người quản lý đã gửi hoa như một cử chỉ bày tỏ sự cảm thông.
example_translations.th_TH: ผู้จัดการส่งดอกไม้เพื่อเป็นการแสดงความเห็นใจ

definition_translations.zh_TW: 表明意圖、感受或態度的行為
definition_translations.ja_JP: 意図、感情、態度を示す行為
definition_translations.ko_KR: 의도, 감정, 태도를 보여 주는 행동
definition_translations.vi_VN: hành động thể hiện ý định, cảm xúc hoặc thái độ
definition_translations.th_TH: การกระทำที่แสดงเจตนา ความรู้สึก หรือท่าที

senses.gloss: to make a movement with the hand, head, or body to communicate
senses.example: She gestured toward the empty chair.

example_translations.ja_JP: 彼女は空いている椅子の方を身ぶりで示した。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그녀는 빈 의자 쪽을 손짓으로 가리켰다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Cô ấy ra hiệu về phía chiếc ghế trống.
example_translations.th_TH: เธอผายมือไปทางเก้าอี้ว่าง

definition_translations.zh_TW: 用手、頭或身體動作來傳達意思
definition_translations.ja_JP: 手、頭、体を動かして伝えること
definition_translations.ko_KR: 손, 머리, 몸을 움직여 의사소통하는 것
definition_translations.vi_VN: cử động tay, đầu hoặc cơ thể để giao tiếp
definition_translations.th_TH: ขยับมือ ศีรษะ หรือร่างกายเพื่อสื่อสาร

translations.ja_JP: 一般的なジェスチャー
